sql: WITH rev AS (SELECT p.brand AS brand, p.product_id AS product_id, p.name AS name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (100 - oi.discount_pct) / 100) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.product_id), ranked AS (SELECT brand, product_id, name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id) AS rn FROM rev) SELECT brand, name FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY brand, rn

sql: WITH s AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (100 - oi.discount_pct) / 100.0 ELSE 0 END) AS s24, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (100 - oi.discount_pct) / 100.0 ELSE 0 END) AS s25 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT c.full_name FROM s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id ORDER BY (s.s25 - s.s24) DESC, c.customer_id LIMIT 1

sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) AS thang FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY (SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (100 - oi.discount_pct) / 100.0) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.cost_price)) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (100 - oi.discount_pct) / 100.0) DESC, thang ASC LIMIT 1
